title: Retail Inflation Moderates to 4.85% as Food Price Pressures Ease

title: Manufacturing Sector Adds 250,000 Jobs on Strong Domestic Demand
description: Increased capital expenditure and resilient industrial activity boosted formal employment across manufacturing and auto sectors.

title: Crude Oil Volatility Prompts Fresh Scrutiny Over Import Bill and Inflation

title: Service Sector PMI Climbs to Multi-Month High on Tech Hiring and Exports

title: Trade Deficit Narrows as Non-Oil Exports Rebound in Fourth Quarter
